title: How a Godly Man Handles Getting Passed Over for a Promotion He Earned
caption:
The promotion went to someone else. Your work didn't get worse. Your reasons for doing it just got tested.

A godly man is allowed to be disappointed. He's not allowed to let the disappointment decide how hard he works tomorrow, or how he treats the guy who got the job he wanted.

Grieve it honest. Work it out anyway. Bless the man who got the title you didn't. That's the actual promotion.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #integrity
